```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
library(ggspatial)
library(crstools)
library(tidypopgen)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s09_data_source_map/"
```

# Create a map showing data collection locations in Madagascar

```{r}
target <- c("Madagascar", "Mozambique", "Comoros", "Mauritius", "Seychelles", "Mayotte", "United Republic of Tanzania", "Malawi", "Zimbabwe", "South Africa", "Eswatini", "Zambia", "Lesotho", "Somalia", "Kenya", "Ethiopia", "Uganda", "Rwanda", "Burundi", "Djibouti", "Eritrea", "South Sudan", "Botswana", "Namibia", "Angola", "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Central African Republic", "Republic of the Congo", "Equatorial Guinea", "Cameroon")

# @TODO "Reunion" "Equatorial Guinea"!!
madagascar_inset <- ne_countries(
  country = target,
  type = "map_units",
  scale = 50
)
```

```{r}
# Dissolve map country boundaries into a single geometry
madagascar_dissolved <- madagascar_inset %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf() # Convert back to sf object
```

```{r}
# Africa
africa <- ne_countries(
  continent = "Africa",
  scale = 50,
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  st_union() %>%
  st_as_sf()
```

# Read in sampling locations

```{r}
kml_data <-
  readRDS("../data/raw/data_input/sampling_locations_with_pierron.rds")

# add a column to indicate whether they are from our sample or
# from the literature
ours <- rep(0, 5)
pierron <- rep(1, 9)
sample <- c(ours, pierron)
kml_data$sample <- sample
```


```{r}
kml_data <- kml_data %>%
  mutate(
    x = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    y = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]
  )

labels_data <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(x),
    y = mean(y),
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry))
  )

# Replace kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" with "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Sakalava_Tsimihety"] <- "Sakalava/Tsimihety"
# Replace kmldata$Name == "Diego" with "Diego Mixed"
kml_data$Name[kml_data$Name == "Diego"] <- "Diego Mixed"
```

```{r}
kml_data_single_site <- kml_data %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarize(geometry = st_union(geometry)) %>%
  st_centroid()
```

# Map with population symbols

```{r}
kml_data <- kml_data[order(kml_data$Name), ]

kml_data$shape <- c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 19, 21, 23)

main_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = madagascar_dissolved) +
  geom_sf(
    data = sf::st_as_sf(kml_data),
    aes(shape = Name, color = Name, fill = Name), size = 2
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(29702),
    xlim = c(-1000000, 1800000),
    ylim = c(1, 2000000),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 3, 7, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23)) +
  labs(shape = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL, shape = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.65),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )

main_map
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "madagascar_map_pca_symbols.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
coords_gt_path <-
  "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_coords.gt"
coord_gt <- gt_load(coords_gt_path)
coord_gt$Latitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Sumba", -9.4, coord_gt$Latitude)
coord_gt$Longitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Sumba", 120.0, coord_gt$Longitude)
coord_gt$Latitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Timor", -9.14, coord_gt$Latitude)
coord_gt$Longitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Timor", 124.56, coord_gt$Longitude)
# approximate location for Borneo populations
coord_gt$Latitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Borneo", -2, coord_gt$Latitude)
coord_gt$Longitude <-
  ifelse(coord_gt$population == "Borneo", 115.0, coord_gt$Longitude)
coord_gt <- coord_gt %>% filter(!is.na(Latitude))
coord_gt <- gt_add_sf(coord_gt, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"))
```


# Map of sampling locations

For populations where sampling location metadata was available.

```{r}
new_crs <- suggest_crs(c(-11, 130, -40, 35))

coord_gt <- st_transform(coord_gt, crs = new_crs$proj4)

africa_eurasia <-
  ne_countries(
    continent = c("Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "Oceania"),
    scale = 50, returnclass = "sf"
  )
africa_eurasia <- st_transform(africa_eurasia, crs = new_crs$proj4)

kml_data_single_site <- st_transform(kml_data_single_site, crs = new_crs$proj4)
kml_data_single_site$ours <- c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1)

labels_data <- coord_gt %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  summarise(
    x = mean(as.numeric(Longitude)),
    y = mean(as.numeric(Latitude)),
    geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry))
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = africa_eurasia) +
  geom_sf(
    data = coord_gt$geometry
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = kml_data_single_site$geometry) +
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl", # "bl" = bottom left
    width_hint = 0.2, # Tells R to try and make the bar ~20% of the plot width
    style = "ticks", # Options: "ticks" or "bar"
    unit_category = "metric"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-11, 130), ylim = c(-40, 35),
    default_crs = st_crs(4326),
    crs = new_crs$proj4
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F8FF", color = NA)
  )
ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "data_source_map.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```
